name: Saruman’s Frost
game_text:
<keyword>Spell</keyword>. <keyword>Weather</keyword>. To play, exert an <culture>Isengard</culture> minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site.
Each Hobbit at this site is strength −2. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
flavor_text: The small and weak suffer first from the White Wizard’s powerful sorcery.
